---
title: "Research"
---

My research interests lie in probability theory and statistics, particularly in random graphs, discrete random structures, statistical inference, and probabilistic aspects of quantum error correction. I am especially interested in inference problems on networks and in understanding what can be learned about a random structure from limited observations. More broadly, I am interested in the interplay between probabilistic models, combinatorial structures, and the development of efficient methods for studying their properties. This includes questions of reconstruction, estimation, and hypothesis testing, as well as the asymptotic behavior of random systems.

For papers and preprints, see [Publications](publications.qmd).
